title: Maikura Waypoints
description: Ancient waypoints, teleportation, return crystals, and natural waypoint generation for Minecraft Fabric.
body:
# Maikura Waypoints

Maikura Waypoints is a waypoint and teleportation mod for Minecraft Fabric.

Create personal waypoints, teleport between discovered locations, and explore ancient waypoint structures generated throughout the world.

## Features

### Personal Waypoints

* Create and manage your own waypoints
* Rename, sort, and delete waypoints through an easy-to-use GUI
* Set and manage your HOME location

### Ancient Waypoints

* Discover naturally generated Ancient Waypoints in the world
* Find Inactive Ancient Waypoints and reactivate them using Netherite Ingots
* Build a transportation network across long distances

### Teleportation System

* Teleport directly from the waypoint GUI
* Optional teleportation cost system
* Configurable return crystal system

### Configuration

Available through Mod Menu:

* Teleport Cost ON/OFF
* Return Crystal ON/OFF
* Sort Options ON/OFF

World generation settings are available through the configuration file.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric
